searchText: sounds bad do you have any tips i've never done this before If you are able, write sample implementations and submit PRs to clients. That often is a way to get feedback from them on the EIP. Keep EIPs as short/simple as possible. Complicated EIPs are harder to get people to engage on. If you can, break your EIP up into small useful parts rather than trying to do a monolithic EIP that introduces a lot of changes. However, don't go smaller than "useful change in isolation".
